items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I worked with him before the war... with Don Redman and the band... Syd Catlett again, Tyree Glenn, trumpet player who died

ctx.x: Red Allen, yeah. And we would play dirty hearts, or sometimes rehearsal would start three hours late, we'd start playing hearts. But very memorable times. Most of the guys are dead now. Let's see, Tyree's dead, isn't he. Yeah. Red. Yeah. And yeah, we recorded during that time with -- I think it was during -- no, this was after. I'm getting confused because I worked with him before the war, this is when we did those things with Billie Holiday -- with Don Redman and the band. This is when they had Don Biase and Roy…

We've been here looking through a stack of jazz books, and a stack of records (inaudible). It's rather upsetting. In all of the books that we found, you don't find any reference to John Collins. Yet there's a rather detailed personnel of bands that you played in. Isn't that strange?
